lessons.learning_objectives: Use basic greetings and farewells appropriately.
lessons.targe_language: hola, adiós, buenos días, buenas tardes, buenas noches
lessons.phase_1:
[Bubble Type: Introduction] ¡Hola! Welcome! Today you'll learn basic greetings to start and end conversations in Spanish.
[Bubble Type: Teaching] To say "hello", use "¡Hola!". To say "goodbye", use "¡Adiós!". The 'H' is always silent!
[Bubble Type: Example] ¡Hola, buenos días! (Hello, good morning!)
lessons.phase_2:
[Item 1: Translation] Translate "Hello"
[Target answer: ¡Hola!]
[Explanation: ¡Hola means Hello and the letter H is silent.]
[Item 2: Fill in the blank] "¡_____, nos vemos!"
[Target answer: Adiós]
[Explanation: Adiós is the standard way to say goodbye.]
[Item 3: Multiple Choice] Good morning: A) Buenas noches B) Buenos días C) Buenas tardes
[Target answer: B) Buenos días]
[Explanation: Buenos días translates to good morning.]

lessons.targe_language: me llamo, ¿cómo te llamas?, mucho gusto
lessons.phase_1:
[Bubble Type: Introduction] Welcome! Today you will learn how to ask someone's name and introduce yourself.
[Bubble Type: Teaching] Ask "What's your name?" with "¿Cómo te llamas?". Answer "My name is..." with "Me llamo [name]".
[Bubble Type: Example] — ¿Cómo te llamas? — Me llamo Carlos.
lessons.phase_2:
[Item 1: Translation] Translate "My name is Juan"
[Target answer: Me llamo Juan.]
[Explanation: Me llamo is used for My name is.]
[Item 2: Fill in the blank] "¿Cómo _____ llamas?"
[Target answer: te]
[Explanation: te goes with llamas when asking someone informally.]
[Item 3: Dialogue Completion] Complete: "— ¿Cómo te llamas? — _____, mucho gusto."
[Target answer: Me llamo Maria]
[Explanation: Use Me llamo followed by your name.]

lessons.learning_objectives: Introduce yourself using the verb ser.
lessons.phase_1:
[Bubble Type: Introduction] Hi there! Today you'll learn how to say "I am..." using the Spanish verb "ser".
[Bubble Type: Teaching] Use "Yo soy" to say "I am". You can also drop "yo" and just say "Soy".
[Bubble Type: Example] Yo soy Ana. / Soy estudiante.
lessons.phase_2:
[Item 1: Sentence Building] Arrange: "soy / Yo / Elena"
[Target answer: Yo soy Elena]
[Explanation: Yo soy means I am.]
[Item 2: Fill in the blank] "Yo _____ profesor."
[Target answer: soy]
[Explanation: soy is the 'I am' form of ser.]
[Item 3: Multiple Choice] How do you say "I am"? A) Yo eres B) Yo soy C) Yo es
[Target answer: B) Yo soy]
[Explanation: Yo always pairs with soy.]
